text: Odile Ferrant opened Saltmarsh & Rye on Thursday, bringing the bistro-style restaurant to the waterfront block on Bracken Quay in Merehaven. The chef, formerly of the Alder Row kitchens, said the menu will focus on coastal produce, house-baked breads and rye pasta. Mayor Tomas Vale attended the opening and praised the project as a boost for the local economy. “This is exactly the kind of independent business we want on the harbourfront,” Vale said. Ferrant said the restaurant will seat 54 and employ 11 staff, with dinner service beginning Friday and lunch added next week. The opening drew a steady crowd of residents and visitors despite light rain.
